title: [Event Request] Codeunit 730 "Copy Item": Add price-specific before event
summary: A new before event OnBeforeCopyItemPriceListLines2 is added to the Copy Item codeunit to allow subscribers to intercept price list line copying operations with access to price and amount type parameters.
key_points: New event OnBeforeCopyItemPriceListLines2 fires before copying price list lines in the price-specific overload
Event exposes PriceType and AmountType parameters for subscriber customization
The 2 suffix distinguishes this event from the existing OnBeforeCopyItemPriceListLines for the dispatcher method
Enables extensions to control individual copy operations before filters and inserts
